top_signals.title: What Could Stop the Bond Market Selloff?: 3-Minutes MLIV
top_signals.summary: Anna Edwards, Tom Mackenzie and Paul Dobson break down today's key themes for analysts and investors on "Bloomberg: The Opening Trade."  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Private Markets Set for Delay in Tapping German Pension Cash
top_signals.summary: Private markets funds are set to wait longer than other asset managers to tap an influx of investors in the wake of Germany’s €500 billion ($580 billion) pension reform.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Apple’s 2,275% Gain Under Cook Is Tough Act for Ternus to Follow
top_signals.summary: Apple Inc.’s Tim Cook handed over the reins to John Ternus on Tuesday, capping a tenure as chief executive officer that cemented the company as an iconic global brand and turned its stock into one of the most reliable bets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Recently patched PaperCut zero-days used in data theft attacks
top_signals.summary: Two security vulnerabilities in the PaperCut NG and MF print management software, patched last week after being exploited as zero-days, are now being abused in data theft attacks. [...]

top_signals.title: Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital leads Polymarket’s $1B raise: Report
top_signals.summary: Donald Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital will reportedly lead a $1 billion investment round into Polymarket, which would value the platform at $21 billion, just below Kalshi’s $22 billion valuation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: LSE to Roll Out Tokenized Stocks in Push Into Digital Assets
top_signals.summary: The London Stock Exchange is planning to launch tokenized stocks, backed by London-listed companies, as it looks to further embrace digital assets.
